name: Cultic Opiate
body:
Your cultic tradition achieves deeper communion with its patrons through the use of mind-altering substances.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (alchemy) 1 rank

Benefit(s): Choose one druggmg.

When you use this substance, you attain an almost supernatural openness to your patron.

As long as the drug is providing a beneficial effect, you gain a +1 bonus to one of the following categories: attack rolls; caster level checks and concentration checks; saving throws; or skill checks. If you are good-aligned, this is a sacred bonus; if you are evil, it is a profane bonus. If you are neutral, you must choose which type of bonus to receive; once chosen, it cannot be altered. You take a -2 penalty to saving throws related to addiction against your chosen drug.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
